warning.titlePre: Jaguar E-Pace D165 Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your E-Pace D165 has the Ingenium AJ200D diesel - fitted across the entire X540 generation run - timing chain wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, consistent with the broader Ingenium diesel family used across Jaguar and Land Rover models. We inspect the timing chain, tensioners and guide rails as standard on every AJ200D rebuild and replace them where worn.

The petrol variants in the E-Pace range (P160, P200, P250) use different Ingenium petrol engines, which don't share this specific diesel timing chain pattern. The P300e PHEV uses a 1.5-litre three-cylinder petrol hybrid unit.
warning.source: Source: same broad Ingenium pattern, per G-BRF Jaguar Section 5. Petrol and PHEV variants excluded from this claim per VRF coverage status.
